name: scroll-animation
blurb: Fades and slides in from a direction when scrolled into view.
description: Wraps children in a motion component that triggers animation via scroll. Animates blur, opacity, and translate from a specified direction; fires once when 30% of element is visible.
use_when: Section intros or staggered card lists that should feel interactive as users scroll.
avoid_when: When users are on low-end devices or when motion would be distracting — no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
a11y: Content is not hidden from screen readers (always in DOM). Animation timing is not controllable by keyboard; only triggers on scroll.
